{
  "name": "thermostat",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "description": "Shows when your prompt cache goes cold, and stops the expensive send.",
  "homepage": "https://modmyclaude.com/mods/thermostat",
  "repository": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/tree/main/mods/thermostat#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/privacy",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/terms",
  "author": {
    "name": "modmyclaude"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "prompt-cache",
    "cost",
    "status-line",
    "keep-warm",
    "guard"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "guard": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cold-send guard",
      "description": "hold: stop the first prompt sent on a cold cache once and show what it costs. warn: show the cost and send. off: do nothing.",
      "default": "hold",
      "options": [
        "hold",
        "warn",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "cacheMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Cache window (minutes)",
      "description": "How long the prompt cache stays warm after the last request, used until Claude Code reports its own window. 0 works it out from your login: 60 on a subscription, 5 on an API key.",
      "default": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440
    }
  }
}
